name: Otho
title: Marcus Otho Caesar Augustus
summary: Otho was Roman emperor, ruling for three months from 15 January to 16 April 69. He was the second emperor of the Year of the Four Emperors.
notes: Reign: 3 months and 1 day. Otho had been a close friend of Nero and had hoped to marry Poppaea Sabina before Nero took her. His suicide was praised as noble by some ancient writers. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otho
